comment: Server side of the WebRTC-transport client/server harness (native<->native, WebRTC transport). Connection itself is driven by the process's --listen CLI arg (ws://.../#ws://.../, see create_server_webrtc in networking.cpp), not by this config. Later dump_state/end_time than the plain-UDP scenario (the plain-UDP server config): the WebRTC path has real handshake latency to absorb before the connection completes -- two WebSocket round trips, SDP offer/answer, ICE-lite negotiation, then GNS's own rendezvous handshake on top of that -- not just a UDP connect.
